mechanism_narrative: Sustained four-week upward trend in RETAIL_REC (from -48.7% to -41.3%) indicates accelerating consumer confidence and foot traffic recovery. This momentum continues linearly over the next four weeks, driving RETAIL_REC further above the recent baseline mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 7.4 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the last 28 days, or reverses by more than 3 percentage points week-on-week in any of the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility remains severely depressed (-37.7%) relative to pre-pandemic baseline, indicating sustained remote work adoption. Reduced commuting suppresses incidental retail visits and weekend shopping trips, keeping RETAIL_REC below recovery trajectory over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES remains below -35% for four consecutive weeks
failure_condition: WORKPLACES rises above -30% in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC exceeds its four-week mean by more than 5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station usage remains critically depressed (-69.0%), constraining access to retail districts and shopping centers. When TRANSIT falls below -65%, retail foot traffic cannot recover because destination accessibility is structurally limited. This threshold condition persists over the next four weeks, suppressing RETAIL_REC gains.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -65% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -60% in any of the next two weeks, and RETAIL_REC subsequently increases by more than 4 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: Convergent recovery in GROCERY_PHARM (from -11.6% to -5.0%) and PARKS (from -31.6% to -16.9%) signals growing outdoor and essential-goods mobility. When both categories improve simultaneously, consumers gain confidence to visit retail-recreation venues. The interaction of these two recovery signals over the next four weeks drives RETAIL_REC upward.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both improve week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved 6.6 points over four weeks
fact:PARKS improved 14.7 points over four weeks
failure_condition: Either GROCERY_PHARM or PARKS reverses by more than 3 percentage points in any single week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not exceed its four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated at 20.0%, indicating sustained home-based activity and possible ongoing capacity restrictions on public venues. High residential occupancy constrains retail-recreation mobility through either policy limits or behavioral substitution. This regime persists over the next four weeks, capping RETAIL_REC recovery.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 19% for four consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below 18% in any week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises more than 6 percentage points above its four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-September marks the onset of Australian spring and school holidays (late September 2021). Anticipatory consumer behavior and family outings drive PARKS mobility upward (trend: -31.6% to -16.9%). This seasonal lift in outdoor recreation crowds out retail-recreation visits as consumers substitute toward parks and outdoor venues over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS improves by more than 3 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 14.7 points over four weeks
failure_condition: PARKS does not improve further in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC rises more than 5 percentage points above its four-week mean despite PARKS gains.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility are coupled through commuting behavior. When both remain severely depressed (WORKPLACES -37.7%, TRANSIT -69.0%), the interaction signals a locked-down labor market and transport system. This dual suppression prevents retail-recreation recovery because neither workplace commuting nor transit-enabled shopping trips resume. The interaction persists over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES below -35% AND TRANSIT below -65% simultaneously for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES rises above -30% or TRANSIT rises above -60% in any week over the next four weeks, and RETAIL_REC subsequently increases by more than 4 percentage points.

This confidence signal cascades to retail-recreation venues within one week as consumers extend shopping trips to include discretionary categories.
